lab.HEROES_STORYLINE_DEFAULT_FAIRYTAIL_ELSA_: You there. That look in your eyes... Are you challenging me to a duel?\n\n
Your inventory is full. Why not put it in order?\n\n
Look again, carefully. You don't seem to have the item.\n\n
Who is the strongest one around here?\n\n
Where are the others staying right now?\n\n
lab.HEROES_STORYLINE_DEFAULT_FAIRYTAIL_GRAY_: What, have I got something on me?\n\n
Your inventory looks full right now.\n\n
I don't think you have it.\n\n
(Gray doesn't seem to have any intention of putting his clothes on.)\n\n
Why are you looking at me like that?\n\n
lab.HEROES_STORYLINE_DEFAULT_FAIRYTAIL_LUCY_: This town's a lot cleaner than I expected. I like it!\n\n
Hm? Looks like your inventory's full.\n\n
I don't think you have that item.\n\n
You came back to see me!\n\n
Want me to show you my favorite Celestial Spirit?\n\n
Where on earth did Natsu run off to?\n\n
lab.HEROES_STORYLINE_DEFAULT_FAIRYTAIL_MAKAR: Plenty of pretty young ladies around here too. This place should suit me just fi... Ahem. Never mind.\n\n
Welcome to the Bingo Shop!\nTake your pick.\n
Your inventory seems to be full, my friend.\n\n
You don't have the item. Take another look.\n\n
Is there anything else you need?\n\n
Somehow I have a feeling I'll make some good friends here, too.\n\n
What matters most is the trust we place in one another.\n\n
lab.HEROES_STORYLINE_DEFAULT_FAIRYTAIL_NATSU: Looks like you don't have that thing.\n\n
Hey, you seen anybody around here who uses some really tasty fire?\n\n
This scarf is super important to me.\n\n
lab.HEROES_STORYLINE_DEFAULT_SAO_LISBET_XML_: Hmm, I don't think you have that.\nCheck one more time.\n
lab.HEROES_STORYLINE_EVENT_FAIRYTAIL_ELSA_XM: {Fairytail_ELSA:npc} has something to say. Go to the Mercenary Outpost in Colhen.\n\n
I hear you wish to join Fairy Tail?\n\n

Fairy Tail has a great many powerful wizards.

Do you truly have the skill to earn our recognition?
(You tell her you have no intention of joining Fairy Tail.)\n\n
Very well.\nI shall put you to the test.\n
(She doesn't seem to be listening to a word you say.)\n\n

I hear there are Fomors here called 'Gnolls.'

Defeat the strongest of them, the Gnoll Chieftain, and return.

Prove your strength to me, fair and square,
and I will reconsider.
Complete the {quest_gnoll_chieftain:quest} battle, then talk to {Fairytail_ELSA:NPC}.\n\n

You're quite slow.

Don't tell me you've lost your nerve?

You've returned?

As it turns out, it wasn't you who applied, but someone else.

If that was the case, you should have said so. Why did you make me waste my time?
(You're fairly sure you told her exactly that...)\n\n

I have no wish to hear belated excuses.

I wasted your time, though it was not my intent, so take this.

I don't give this to just anyone.
Take good care of it.
lab.HEROES_STORYLINE_EVENT_FAIRYTAIL_GRAY_XM: {Fairytail_GRAY:npc} has something to say. Go to the Inn in Colhen.\n\n
I've got a personal favor to ask, so I was waiting for you to lend me a hand.\n\n
(Suddenly, Gray starts taking off his clothes.)\n\n

It's kind of a long story.
I'll keep it short.
Lyon once traveled all over looking for a way to become stronger than Ur.

He said that at one point he even passed through this world.

From what I heard, he went to a place called Hoarfrost Hollow,
and saw a huge bear there.
He said he sensed a special kind of power coming from that bear.

If there's still a way, even now...

Please.

Could you at least look into it for me?
(Before you know it, Gray is standing there in just his underwear.)\n\n
Complete the {quest_bear_normal:quest} battle, then talk to {Fairytail_GRAY:NPC}.\n\n

Not yet, huh.

I'll be waiting, so let me know once you've looked into it.
(You tell him you didn't find much of anything.)\n\n

I see. Thanks anyway.

I put together a little something for you.
I'd like you to have it.
lab.HEROES_STORYLINE_EVENT_FAIRYTAIL_MAKAROV: Talk to {Fairytail_MAKAROV:npc}, the master of Fairy Tail, at the Mercenary Outpost in Colhen.\n\n
I've been searching high and low for you, you know.\n\n

Hoho. Forgive me, I haven't introduced myself.
I'm Makarov, the guild master of Fairy Tail.
Whenever an S-Class quest comes in, we're ready to rush off anywhere.

I heard dragons have been appearing around these parts.

So we decided to stay at the Colhen Mercenary Outpost for a few days, 
just until the job is done.
While staying with the mercenaries, I've heard a lot of good things about you.
Word is you're a splendid knight.
So here's the thing.
Why not take on this quest together with us at Fairy Tail?
We happen to need someone who knows this land well, 
and if you ask me, you're just the person for the job.

Good-natured and bold, just as I'd heard!
Splendid.
Hunt the dragons in {quest_dragon_ancient_elculous:quest}, {quest_dragon_ancient_siglint:quest} and {quest_dragon_ancient_bugeikloth:quest}
and bring me {event_fairytail_dragon_piece:item} x9,
and I'll give you something that will be a great help to you.
Even better if you bring them again and again.
Knowing you're on the case puts my old mind at ease.
I'm counting on you, then.

Obtain {event_fairytail_dragon_piece:item} x9 in the {quest_dragon_ancient_elculous:quest}, {quest_dragon_ancient_siglint:quest} and {quest_dragon_ancient_bugeikloth:quest} battles and bring them to {Fairytail_MAKAROV:NPC}.\n\n

Precise as ever.

Here, take the (reward item) I promised you.

Thanks to your efforts, everyone in the guild is giving it their all, too.

I'm counting on you from here on as well.

That's not the right number of {event_fairytail_dragon_piece:item}.

I can wait a while longer, so take care out there.
lab.HEROES_STORYLINE_EVENT_FAIRYTAIL_NATSU_X: {Fairytail_NATSU:npc} has something to say. Go to the Forge in Colhen.\n\n

Finally caught up with ya.
I heard you're a pretty experienced mercenary around here.
Can you do me a favor?

I heard there's a monster in these parts that uses some really tasty fire.

I wanna meet that guy...

You know him?

If you know the way to him,
I want you to lead the way...
I'm countin' on ya!
Complete the {quest_vampire_drinker:quest} battle with {Fairytail_NATSU:NPC}, then talk to him again.\n\n

So when are we heading out?

Let me know when you're ready.

Thanks for showing me the way!
Thanks to you, I got to taste a whole new kind of fire.
Here, take this as a thank-you.
lab.HEROES_STORYLINE_EVENT_FAIRYTAIL_RUCY_XM: {Fairytail_LUCY:npc} has something to say. Go to the General Store in Colhen.\n\n

(Tears seem to be welling up in Lucy's eyes.)

(If you don't help her, she looks like she'll burst into tears any second.)

Thank you! I'm counting on you, {:name}!!

If you bring me all 5 copied keys, I'll make it up to you!

Huh? Oh, hi! Sorry, I didn't notice you were here.

I got caught up in a really tricky problem, and my head's all over the place.
Clodagh told me you're someone I can really trust.\n\n

(Clodagh gives you a meaningful smile and a wink.)

(You force the friendliest smile you can manage and keep listening.)

I have some keys that are really precious to me.

They're like a part of me.

On my way over to this world, I went through a lot of rough journeys.

Along the way, I lost some of those keys for a while before I got them back.

I think that's when the keys ended up in the hands of the Fomors here for a little while.

And while the Fomors had them, I think they made copies of some of them.

Because of that, my Celestial Spirits have been going through all kinds of trouble.

It might not look like a big deal to anyone else...

But I feel so bad that my spirits are suffering because of my mistake...

So I want to get back every last one of those copied keys.

But I don't know my way around here at all, so I'm kind of worried.

{:name}, could you help me find the copied keys?

There are 5 copied keys in all.

Obtain {key_fairytail_aquarius:item}, {key_fairytail_leo:item}, {key_fairytail_capricorn:item}, {key_fairytail_virgo:item} and {key_fairytail_aries:item} in battle and bring them to {Fairytail_LUCY:npc}.\n\n

Just as I thought, the keys you found look a lot like mine.

Here, a gift to say thanks! Will you take it?

Oh, right! And if you find any more, be sure to let me know!

Hmm... Could you look for a few more keys?

If you find all 5, I'll give you a really nice present!
lab.HEROES_STORYLINE_EVENT_MONSTERBINGO_FAIR: Go see {Fairytail_MAKAROV:npc} at the Mercenary Outpost in Colhen.\n\n
How's the hunt for bingo numbers coming along?\n\n

I had a feeling you'd say that, so I got a few ready for you.

Here, take these.

Use them to exchange for the numbers you want at the [point]Bingo Shop[/point].

Good luck to you, then.

Ah, you've come at just the right time.

On my way over to these parts,
I picked up a little game called bingo.
Do you see this [point]Bingo[/point] board here?

You see, bingo is a game
where you collect the numbers you see here
and connect them in a row, a column or a diagonal.

And when you complete a line, what you shout is 
[point]Bingo![/point]
What's more, anyone who completes even a single line 
receives a gift for each line.
Who taught me, you ask?

It was a cat wearing a black robe.
I never did see its face.
The two of us made a wager
on who could complete the whole board first.
Hoho, he told me that every single day he'd hide one new number
on two different monsters.
And when he has time to spare, he'll hide two numbers
on four monsters, he said.
Hmm, I've been out collecting them myself lately.
And I must say, it's got my competitive spirit going.
Which monsters could he have hidden them on...
I've been asking around and searching for them myself.
I reckon we'd gather them faster if we worked together.
What do you say? Care to join me?

Once a day, I'll give you a ticket you can exchange
for any number you want from the ones I've collected.
I'll keep the [point]Bingo Shop[/point] open,
so come trade in your tickets once you've gathered them.
Each line comes with a different gift,
so pick the lines you want carefully and fill them in.
Good luck to you, then.
Come back and see {Fairytail_MAKAROV:npc} again tomorrow.\n\n

What is it?

Looking to get more {coupon_bingo_pink_fairytail_2014:item}?

I'm sorry, my friend, but I haven't any left today.
So come back tomorrow.
When you do, I'll be sure to give you another one.
